crossRefs.note: Have we no right to eat and to drink?
Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go…
But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.
Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

translations.web: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.
translations.bsb: In the same way, the Lord has prescribed that those who preach the gospel should receive their living from the gospel.
translations.kjv: Even so hath ➔ the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.
translations.asv: Even so did the Lord ordain that they that proclaim the gospel should live of the gospel.
